free_tier.stated: no free plan: VPS Lite is 'From CHF 2.70 /month' on an annual commitment with 'Unlimited traffic with 500 Mb/s bandwidth'
free_tier.notes: A third-party index reports no trial for VPS Lite; the CHF 300 credit applies to Public Cloud only.

egress.terms: Unlimited traffic at 500 Mb/s; a third-party index adds 'limited by port speed and fair use'; the monthly price assumes 12 months paid in one payment; inbound UDP policy is not stated on the pages read

interface_detail: SSH to the VPS public IPv4 address
tooling: wg-quick or any VPN daemon inside the guest
chaining: a CHF 2.70 a month origin in Switzerland with no byte cap; the cost is a 12-month prepayment and the wall is the 500 Mb/s port

limits.value: 500 Mb/s bandwidth with unlimited traffic; 'limited by port speed and fair use' on a third-party index

binding_note: at 1 TiB a month no byte quota is published; 500 Mb/s would carry about 160 TB a month, so the 12-month prepayment is the first cost to bite, not a limit

identity_cost.detail: VPS payment methods are cards, PostFinance, bank transfer, PayPal, Twint or a prepaid balance; an order flagged for spam or fraud needs an ID check with a selfie through the kCheck app (third-party index); the vendor's order page was not read

reliability_note: unverified: no suspension, throttle or data-loss behaviour is stated on the pages read; VPS Lite is unmanaged
confidence_note: price, term and port are quoted from the vendor's VPS Lite page read on 2026-11-04; payment and ID-check rules rest on a third-party index and are reported; no server was ordered and no port was probed
